Class Abilities

1st Level — Class Skills

All of the following abilities are gained at 1st level. Each uses the associated attribute for checks.

Study

  • Effect: As your action, study one creature you can see; from the start of your next turn it is your Studied target until the end of the encounter. You may study before a fight. A Death Attack needs two rounds of study at 1st level, and one from 9th.

Death Attack

  • Effect: Delivered by a Sneak Attack against your Studied target once it has had the study a Death Attack needs: on a hit that deals damage, the target makes a Fortitude save against your Class Save DC or dies instantly.
  • Death Attack works only on a target whose Level does not exceed your Assassin level plus 2.
  • Against a solo, a failed save is a kill effect: it loses its next two turns (see Solo Creatures, Book IV).
  • Save succeeds: attack deals the maximum on its Sneak Attack dice instead

Sneak Attack

  • Effect: Advantage on the attack roll plus a scaling damage die (see the Assassin Progression Table) against a creature that cannot see you, has not yet acted this encounter, or is your Studied target. Usable once per round.
  • Usable at range within 30ft
  • No prior stealth check required
  • A Death Attack is delivered by a Sneak Attack; if the target saves, it takes maximum Sneak Attack dice damage

First Blood

  • Effect: Your Sneak Attack against a creature that has not yet acted this encounter deals one extra die.

Killer's Precision

  • Effect: Your weapon attacks deal +1 damage per three Assassin levels (minimum +1). This applies to every hit, not only Sneak Attacks.

Assassin's Skills

  • Effect: Trained in Climb, Disguise and Traps (Book II), on top of your 3 starting skills, and Master in Traps from 7th level. You roll Climb with Dexterity. Hide and Move Silently count as Stealth, and Listen as Perception, for kits, feats and other features.
  • Case Target (Wisdom): spend 1d3×10 minutes observing a target. On a successful check you learn its approximate Level, its Allegiance (most mortals are Unaligned), any hidden weapons or unusual items, and its habits and mannerisms; the GM adjusts for the target's power.
  • Disguise (Charisma): 1d3×10 minutes for a general disguise, 1 month for a specific individual; apparent height and weight change by no more than a tenth. The GM rolls secretly, and the more your disguise differs from your own build, age and ancestry, and the more suspicious the observer, the harder the check.
  • Hide, Move Silently (Dexterity) and Listen (Wisdom): no penalty at half speed or slower, Disadvantage above it, impossible while running.
  • You count as Hidden while lightly obscured even on a result of 12 to 14, and Listen has Disadvantage through stone.
  • From 3rd level you may attempt Hide and Move Silently together, at quarter speed, with Disadvantage on both.
  • Identify Poison (Intelligence): identify any poison or antitoxin on a successful check, and make poisons or antitoxins with alchemical equipment for a third of their street value. You never risk poisoning yourself when applying poison to a blade.

2nd Level

Quiet Kill

  • Effect: A creature you reduce to 0 HP or below with a Sneak Attack makes no sound as it falls. Nearby creatures get no check to notice the kill by sound alone.

3rd Level

Ambush Predator

  • Effect: You have Advantage on initiative.

4th Level

Poisoner's Edge

  • Effect: A poison you apply to a weapon lasts for 3 hits instead of 1, and the target makes its save against it with Disadvantage.

5th Level

Twist the Knife

  • Effect: When you use your action to attack, make one additional weapon attack as part of it, with Disadvantage (see Extra attacks in The Arneyan Codex).
  • No Disadvantage against a Poisoned creature.
  • If both attacks hit one creature, it can't regain Hit Points until the end of its next turn.
  • Sneak Attack still applies to only one attack per round.

6th Level

Dossier

  • Effect: After a successful Case Target check you have Advantage on checks to track or tail that creature for a day, and it is your Studied target from the start of your next fight with it.

7th Level

Lethal Dose

  • Effect: The first hit each fight with a poisoned weapon also deals +1d6 poison damage. The target makes a Fortitude save against your Class Save DC to negate the extra damage.

Shadow Step

  • Effect: When you reduce a creature to 0 HP or below with a Sneak Attack, or when you Hide, you may move up to 15ft without provoking Attacks of Opportunity.

8th Level

Many Faces

  • Effect: A general disguise takes 5 minutes, and a disguise as a specific individual takes 1 week instead of a month.

10th Level

Venom Tolerance

  • Effect: You have Advantage on saves against poison.

12th Level

Finishing Blow

  • Effect: A Sneak Attack that is a critical hit against a creature at half its HP or less deals maximum damage on its Sneak Attack dice.

13th Level

Surprise

  • Effect: Your Hide result counts one tier higher against creatures you ambush.

14th Level

Reaper's Reach

  • Effect: You can Cleave with any attack, not only a melee weapon, and a Cleave attack can be a Sneak Attack.

15th Level

Dexterity Bonus

  • Effect: Gain a permanent +1 to Dexterity.

Signature Style

  • Effect: Choose one type of attack, poison, or tactic used throughout your career.
  • When executing a Death Attack using this signature style, the target makes its Fortitude save with Disadvantage.

18th Level

Cold Blood

  • Effect: Your Sneak Attack dice ignore resistance to physical damage (not immunity), and your Studied target has Disadvantage on its first save against you each encounter.

19th Level

Perfect Study

  • Effect: You may study as part of an attack instead of as your action.

20th Level

Renown: Shadow Guild

  • Effect: You may found a shadow guild (see Renown in The Arneyan Codex); each season 1d4 apprentices and a poisoner join it. While you hold it, once a season a Dossier arrives unbidden on a creature of your choice, as if you had made a successful Case Target check against it.

21st Level

Marked for Death

  • Effect: A creature you have a Dossier on makes its Death Attack save with Disadvantage.

24th Level

Marked for Death (Improved)

  • Effect: Your Sneak Attack hits on a creature you have a Dossier on open a wound: it loses 1d6 HP at the start of each of its turns until healed or bandaged (one wound at a time; against a solo, the bleeding ends when it becomes Bloodied), and it regains HP at half the normal rate, magical healing included. Creatures that don't bleed are unaffected.

Kits: Assassin Guilds and Traditions

Each kit is an item in the Kits compendium, in the Assassin folder. Drag one onto your character.

Choose one Kit at character creation. Your kit defines your guild, tradition, and the network you belong to — or fled from.
